tools.name: search_the_shop
tools.title: Search this shop
tools.description: Search the Fernweh range from the page itself and return each match with its SKU, price, whether it is in stock and its link — the same catalogue the shop pages show.

query.description: What the shopper is after, e.g. 'waxed canvas' or 'merino'

inStockOnly.description: Leave out anything that is out of stock

tools.name: view_cart
tools.title: Read the cart
tools.description: What is in this visitor's cart right now, with each line, the item count, the delivery line and the total.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.title: Add an item to the cart
tools.description: Put one of Fernweh's products in this visitor's cart by SKU or by name, and report the cart back. Changes the page, so it is confirmed before it runs.

sku.description: The SKU (e.g. FW-PK-W28) or the product's name

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.title: Take an item out of the cart
tools.description: Remove one line from this visitor's cart by SKU or by name, and report what is left. Changes the page, so it is confirmed before it runs.

sku.description: The SKU or name of the line to remove

tools.name: open_product
tools.title: Open a product page
tools.description: Take this browser to one product's own page, by SKU or by name — the same thing clicking the product in the shop does.

sku.description: The SKU or the product's name

tools.name: who_is_signed_in
tools.title: Who is signed in here
tools.description: Whether a customer is signed in to this store in this browser, and their display name if they are. Reports no personal detail beyond the name the store already shows them.
